metadata.description: Traction Studio skills for Claude Code, the Claude app, Codex, and Grok.

plugins.name: gauntlet
plugins.description: Reviews a committed code diff with two independent engines.

plugins.name: doc-gauntlet
plugins.description: Reviews a committed plan or requirements document with six breadth lenses and two independent engines, returning a sparring memo and a list of true errors.

plugins.name: persona-teardown
plugins.description: Tears down a prototype with a panel of cold persona agents driving a browser and consolidates the findings into one design-tool amendment prompt.

plugins.name: ruling-page
plugins.description: Turns a complicated decision into a clickable one-file HTML ruling page: a recommendation pre-selected on every card, alternatives as buttons, and one button that copies the answers back into chat.

plugins.name: call-prep
plugins.description: Writes a verbatim call script as one interactive HTML page read live on a second screen: a guard line of what not to say, numbered beats with the exact lines, fallbacks for pushback and answers to the hardest questions.
